description: Look up a single FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) event by its event key. Returns metadata (event name, year, week, type, location, dates, district), aggregate EPA stats for participating teams, qualification and playoff status, and Statbotics predictions for the event (e.g. winner probabilities). Event keys follow the format `<year><event-code>`, e.g. "2024flor" (FLOR = Orlando regional 2024), "2024necmp" (New England district championship 2024), "2024cmptx" (Houston champs 2024). Use this to answer "what happened at 2024flor?", "show predictions for 2024cmptx", or to get context (week, type, location) for an event you have the key for. For browsing events by season, district, or week, use get_events.
name: get_event
